successors.name: Kingdom of Northumbria
successors.text: Lindsey; Cliopatria's Northumbria shape from 626 holds 17 of its 18 cells

ledger.x: c. 450: Lindsey is one of the lesser Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. 'from about 450, Lindsey was one of the lesser kingdoms'; 'Its subjugation may have occurred around AD 500'. The year is the page's loose date; the land is the page's description of the boundaries and Cliopatria's shape.
625: Lindsey's last year in Cliopatria; Northumbria's shape holds its land from 626.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line; the boundaries on the Witham, Trent, Foss Dyke and the Isle of Axholme are the page's description of a frontier, not a dated line.
